test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_top_k_string.parquet', Parquet) SELECT leftPad(toString(k), 9, '0') AS s, if(number % 10 = 0, '', s) AS e, toString(number) AS p FROM (SELECT (number % 100000) + 100000 * ((intDiv(number, 100000) * 37 + 11) % 200) AS k, number FROM numbers(20000000)) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 100000, max_block_size = 100000, max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
test.query: SELECT s, p FROM file('test_parquet_top_k_string.parquet') ORDER BY s LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
SELECT s, p FROM file('test_parquet_top_k_string.parquet') ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
SELECT e, p FROM file('test_parquet_top_k_string.parquet') WHERE e != '' ORDER BY e LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
SELECT e, p FROM file('test_parquet_top_k_string.parquet') ORDER BY e DESC LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
